terms.comment: The frequentative (L&S). Traupman’s crocitāre is attested only in the late Carmen dē Philomēlā; not recommended.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
